mission: L9 section 6 — stateful planner strategy matrix
phase_order: dev measured first; heldout_l9 measured afterwards, once, after the dev block and its analysis were frozen; its outcomes can no longer influence anything
known_preexisting_fp: dv-103 (docvault ambiguous) confirms /orbit/osier-notice as an IDENTITY_BOUNDARY finding at budgets 8/16/32 under ALL four strategies, including baseline A — the same finding at the same budgets under the same engine is already recorded in the frozen L8 dev matrix (docs/l8_discovery_dev.json); the L9 changes introduced no new false positive
honesty_note: synthetic loopback results over independently implemented fixture applications; they support no real-world generalization claim

strategy_definitions.l8-engine: A: the L8 adaptive engine unchanged — no planner, no remediation hook
strategy_definitions.planner: B: the L9 stateful planner — declared preconditions, dependency-graph setup derivation, remediated re-runs
strategy_definitions.planner-no-prereq: C: the same planner with prerequisite reasoning ablated — candidate generation identical to B, blocked outcomes never remediated
strategy_definitions.fixed-prereq: D: an independently generated fixed prerequisite strategy — a static per-family recipe list built without reading the planner's derivation logic

metric_units.requests: engine observations recorded in the observation ledger (one per HTTP exchange the engine issued)
metric_units.http_requests: every request the serving stack answered, including index fetches
metric_units.tp: ground-truth defects confirmed (deduplicated: one defect = one finding)
metric_units.fp: confirmed findings matching no ground-truth defect on the instance
metric_units.prerequisites: per-strategy accounting of setup attempts: the planner's ledger tally for B/C, the fixed strategy's own tally (identified/verified/failed/unknown) for D, empty for A
metric_units.blocked_or_inconclusive_hypotheses: hypotheses left blocked/inconclusive — the non-verdict status a failed setup must always produce (§3)
